title: What Makes a Good Story and How Can We Measure It? A Comprehensive Survey of Story Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance variations and sensitivity of LLM evaluators when presented with different prompt formats.
Comparing evaluation outcomes when the order of displayed candidates is changed to test if the model favors the first option.
Assessing the tendency of LLM evaluators to favor memorized texts or self-generated stories, tested via techniques like replacing proper nouns.
Quantifying changes in generation probability metrics caused by superficial textual differences or applying specific text perturbations.
